_comment: The report commands that were merged into one or taken away (spec docs/requirements/active/2026-10-19-base-saine-nettoyage.md, REQ-001, REQ-002, D-13), and what a call of each becomes. The one list of them: calc/domains/commands_migrate.py rewrites a project's sections from it when the project is opened (each file saved into the archives first), the export refuses a section that still calls one and names its replacement, and tests/test_commands_migrate.py holds that no template, example or engine file calls an old name. `to` is the command a call becomes; `prepend` / `append` are the arguments written before / after the call's own; a `removed` command has no replacement a call can be rewritten into, and its text says what to write instead. Since 1.1 (spec docs/requirements/completed/2026-10-21-commandes-typst-refonte.md, REQ-020, ARCH-006) the commands that spec retires are `removed` entries and never `to`: a project is carried over by hand, and what it still calls is said, at its file and line, when it is opened and when it is exported. `arguments` is the same for an argument a command that stays no longer takes: {command: {argument: what to write instead}}.
